entry.title: When familiar sleep changes
entry.summary: The authors describe changing sleep as a time to notice what is different and offer needed support. Their developmental examples are possibilities, not an explanation for every waking baby.
entry.cue: Sleep has changed from the pattern you had come to know.
detail: The book mentions changes around eight months as one example, while also asking about comfort, surroundings and the baby’s response. More help may be needed for a time.
The authors return to observing readiness before reducing that help again. Their examples do not set a deadline for sleep to return to a previous pattern.
